propositions: CLI rebar transition ... closed --ref HEAD falsely reports no referencing commit when REBAR_TRACKER_DIR is out-of-worktree, even though the commit carries the ticket trailer in the current code checkout.
close_precheck._completion_precheck derives code_root as os.path.dirname(tracker), causing git log to scan the tracker parent instead of the current code repository, breaking trailer detection.
completion-gate configuration and file-impact checks are incorrectly rooted to the tracker parent directory instead of the explicit code repository, causing silent gate bypass or false rejection.
Fixing only the git -C invocation leaves completion-gate and autoresume config still rooted to tracker parent; both code-root usages must normalize through config.repo_root(repo_root).
Default in-repo tracker behavior and true-missing-commit diagnostics must remain unchanged after repair.
